title: PC liquid-cooling manifold
summary: A constrained acrylic distribution-plate study combines three 12 mm reservoir channels, a separate stair-shaped point-to-point passage, rounded walls, five port bores, one enclosing 2.4 mm silicone seal groove and an external fastener stack.

provenance.name: GeoSolve independently drawn PC water-manifold study
provenance.scope: Planar acrylic-plate layout only; no flow, pressure, sealing, thermal or manufacturing guarantee.
